name: Nereid Deep
bagName: SET_Azure Coast · Nereid Deep R7 · Public Terrain
description: A partly flooded underwater research base with two open decks, detailed laboratories and living quarters, four stairways, two service ladders and dry upper-deck bypasses.
mapRules:
NO AERIAL: Army lists for THIS MAP cannot include profiles with the Aerial characteristic. This restriction applies only to Nereid Deep.

SHALLOW WATER (light blue, pale edge): Aquatic Difficult Terrain. Terrain (Aquatic) or Terrain (Total) ignores its movement difficulty.

DEEP WATER (dark blue, yellow edge): IMPASSABLE unless the Trooper has Terrain (Aquatic) or Terrain (Total). Those Troopers may traverse it normally.

Azure Coast Tidal Channels applies to both water types. With Terrain (Aquatic/Total), a base wholly inside water gains water-based Total Cover. An observer with either skill ignores that protection; solid scenery still blocks LoF. This map also prohibits profiles with the Aerial characteristic.

A Skill that normally breaks Stealth removes water-based protection for the rest of the Order; it returns afterwards if eligible.
controls: Upper Deck LIFT/STACK carries resting figures so the lower floor is accessible. Stack before line-of-fire, cross-deck measurements or deployment checks. Clear Table returns carried figures. Booty, Metachemistry, independent DZ/+4/+8 and day/night controls remain.
scope: Public terrain. Choose the mission separately; the future narrative mission is not published. Optional DZ guides use a standard 12-inch depth; follow the chosen mission.
